meta.title: perf: optimize app loading and rendering performance with TypeScript fix
meta.body_summary: Claims to fix TypeScript type checking issues (null check, TS version revert) but the title and initial body misrepresent the PR as containing performance optimizations like caching and memoization.

perf_labels.notes: PR title and initial body claimed performance optimizations, but actual changes were only a tiny TS null fix and TS version revert. Maintainer closed after noting absence of claimed caching/memoization/code-splitting.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: Extremely small change (2-line null check + TS version revert) that does not match the performance claim; closed quickly after maintainer identified the disconnect.

review_details.concern_detail: retrogtx noted that the described performance optimizations (caching, memoization, code splitting) are absent from the code diff; Devin acknowledged they belong to another PR, but the PR was closed immediately.
review_details.performance_claim: Optimize app loading and rendering performance (from the title and initial body).
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed after pointing out missing changes; no request for benchmarks or further iteration.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent submitted a PR with a title/description claiming performance improvements but the actual diff was unrelated TS fixes; the maintainer rejected it without engaging on performance metrics.

detection_detail.code_reading: retrogtx compared the PR description with the file diffs and immediately identified that the claimed optimizations were not present.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance materials or measurements existed; the PR only contained a null check and TS version revert.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed within minutes of maintainer comment, with no follow-up commits.

core_change_summary.description: Fixed a potential null error in TeamsListing.tsx by adding optional chaining to searchParams; reverted TypeScript version in package.json and yarn.lock to resolve a compiler bug.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Lockfile reflects the TS version revert.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: optional chaining fix for searchParams.
Second commit: TypeScript version revert to fix compiler bug.
Maintainer review noted missing performance items; Devin acknowledged and pointed to another PR; PR closed without further changes.
